description: Model per role, chosen on measured merit (quality per dollar on the Gate Keeper benchmark), not by default. Re-test with method@model arms whenever a new model ships; change a role only through the same qualification.

reviewer.why: 48/48 key issues, 7 false positives (plain reviewer 15); Opus 5.5 gave 6 at ~2.4x cost

repair.why: 6/6 fixtures first attempt; Opus 5.5 repairer showed no gain

adjudicator.why: Grades and gates. Fable 5.1 (the baseline grader) is not on the TrueFoundry gateway; Opus 5.5 is the strongest model there and is not the reviewer under test (Sonnet 5.5).
adjudicator.calibration: Before re-baselining, re-grade the locked run gk-live-20261101-g findings with Opus 5.5 and compare against the Fable 5.1 judgements; adopt only if agreement holds on matched key issues and false positives.

learning.why: Lesson capture and shared-rule selection: low volume, judgement-heavy, errors spread to every tenant

triage.why: Haiku 5.5 missed 5-8/48 key issues reviewing alone; triage in front of the reviewer is untested

route_note: The agent operates only through TrueFoundry: the owner's account or the stranger-builds allowance (config/truefoundry-gateway.json). Model ids are <TrueForge provider>/<model>. Direct provider keys are not used.
